blocks.text: Player-visible change

The existing unconditional purchase stays available. Two opt-in agreements require 18 or 26 actual league appearances before the existing permanent move can complete. Completion retains the current two-year deal and existing weekly wage.
Approved compatibility contract

items: Only conditional agreements add loanBuy.minimumLeagueApps?: 18 | 26. The existing ready value remains a boolean.
Use actual recorded leagueApps. It must be a safe integer from zero through total appearances. The completed programme ledger, season record, selected choice and threshold tag must agree.
Recheck sealed proof when completing. Missing, contradictory or mismatched conditional proof refuses the move without resetting the source state.
Absent metadata keeps legacy unconditional behavior exactly, including old receipt-less ready:true saves. A known conditional receipt with its tag deleted refuses.
Unknown or null threshold metadata is preserved and refused. Queue/cancel must not silently rewrite unreadable metadata.

A severe-injury year may stop at rehab before contract decrement or loan review. Preserve the existing loan, borrower and contract years at that early boundary. Do not promise immediate parent return.

pages.title: Club Manager: pause a position course
pages.subtitle: Fifth batch | Further partial CM-32 | Critical final compatibility correction

blocks.text: Player-visible change

Pause and resume an existing matching secondary-position course while keeping earned weeks. Pausing preserves course progress and learned roles. Resuming removes the pause flag. Existing Stop still cancels the entire course.
Reducer and save contract

items: startRetraining(career,id,to,paused?) keeps its original behavior when paused is undefined. A boolean only toggles a valid existing same-target course.

The optional Retraining.paused value is unknown at the reader boundary so future metadata remains lossless. Absent or false keeps ordinary paid progression. True or an unknown own pause value freezes course/learned-role progression only.
Invalid players, courses, targets, stale already-held targets, invalid counts, extra future course fields and nonboolean toggle arguments refuse safely.
No changes to fitness, growth, recovery, position limits, RNG sites or coefficients. Existing Light recovery remains intact.

blocks.label: Do not ship the beta engine/UI
blocks.text: The first passing build used engine eb56141f and UI c8713633. Their new 'in' checks throw on primitive course values accepted by the old reader. Final engine 63dec52c and UI cb2b02e8 replace two read sites with safe own-property checks. That final successor is not yet build-qualified.
Tests and real results

The five-case test has four owned changes and one held ordinary case. It checks actual learned-role retention and an actual XI fit-strength difference, not copied model math. New held vectors also cover loadable primitive string/number courses.

First integrated run had two CM expected-state failures. JSON cloning dropped pre-existing undefined keys; final test cbe2093a changes those expectations to structuredClone. Product reducer behavior was not changed to satisfy the snapshots.
Required physical control

Restore only the two safe reads to the unsafe beta strings; assert exact beta engine/UI hashes. The held ordinary case must fail CM_RETRAIN_SCALAR_COMPAT with captured 'in' TypeErrors from the actual tick and render paths. Restore the exact final source, pass again and compare full ordinary RAW. Do not weaken the generic owned-failure classifier.

Native module covers pause, existing Light recovery, a real paid January window, resume and exact reload bytes. Scalar compatibility and unknown metadata remain unit scope. No fifth native runtime result exists yet.

pages.title: NBA/NFL: review before signing
pages.subtitle: Fifth batch | Owner-priority adaptation of PL-16 | Source-ready, not released

blocks.text: Player-visible change

NBA and NFL free-agent offers open a review before signing. Back closes the review without writing. Confirm uses the existing signing path once, provided the actual selected offer and terms are still current. Other sports retain immediate signing.
Exact safety contract

items: FreeAgencyPanel accepts reviewSigning?: boolean, default false. UsCareerBoard opts in only for sport.slug nba/nfl.
The dialog keeps the underlying offer list mounted. Opening and Back perform no write, RNG draw or signing callback.
Capture current window identity, selected offer object identity and cloned scalar offer terms. Confirm rejects a replaced, mutated, withdrawn or reused offer/index.
Consume the pending request before invoking the original callback. Preserve the existing signing model and save fence.
Review-heading focus and return to the connected opener use preventScroll. The native check prepares the same pointer action before recording exact scroll equality.

blocks.text: Non-negotiable product rules

items: Do not add real sports data without the data-guardian process and two-source verification. No club/league marks, player photos, invented real-person quotes or rival product names in shipped files.
No new database/provider work, dependency-lock changes, coefficients, RNG sites, active-save resets or cap increases in this batch.
Use SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY from the existing client. Lovable's VITE_SUPABASE_* values point to a deleted project.
Preserve save compatibility, legal footer, instructions and re-openable help, small tiles/back navigation and no page jumps. No em or en dashes in copy, comments, commits or messages.
